q-0495.answer:
Surah Al-Hujuraat (49) — The Inner Apartments · 18 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Do not rush in making decisions before him, rather, follow his lead in all matters.
• O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before Allah and His Messenger but fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing.
• O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.
• Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allah - they are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.
• And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allah. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0510.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

Surah Al-Qaari'a (101) — The Calamity · 11 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• In their scattering, their dividing, their coming and their going, all due to being bewildered at what is happening to them, they will be like scattered moths.

Main teachings:
• He is Witness to their deeds, recording and enumerating them precisely, and He will requite them for them in full.
• Which is that if Allah willed, He could cause the wind to cease, in which case the ships would stop moving, or He could make the wind fierce, in which case the ships would be lost and destroyed.
• You are just a warner, and Allah is the Trustee of all affairs.
